name: Harmonic drive joint, size 17 (50:1)
note: Frameless brushless motor on a 50:1 harmonic gear, like a robot-arm joint. Strong and precise, barely backdrivable. The motor's own rotor, spun 50 times faster, adds inertia the joint has to accelerate (rotor inertia x ratio squared).
source: Typical of size-17 harmonic joint modules (e.g. CSF-17-50: rated about 21 N·m, repeated peak about 44-70 N·m, input up to 7300 rpm); top speed 8 rad/s is the motor at a 48 V bus (about 3800 rpm input), not the gear's limit; approximate.
